label: Party dresses
finding: 266 dresses are 50% off across 18 stores, but only 117 of them are party dresses, in 8 stores, and 87 of those sit in just two: Marcella and Mac Duggal.

picks.name: Liore cutout dress, red
picks.say: Seventy-one dollars for a red dress with one shoulder and a cutout. It's ponte, so it's thick and it holds you in.
picks.why: Red, mid-stretch ponte, ankle length, back slit. $71 from $178.
picks.for_who: Office party or dinner where you want one clean red dress.
picks.skip_if: You want to wear a normal bra. The cutout won't allow it.

picks.name: Black bow mini
picks.say: Mac Duggal is prom-heavy, but this one is good. Ruched taffeta mini with a bow that drops to the floor.
picks.why: Fully lined taffeta, strapless, 35 inches long. $159 from $348.
picks.for_who: New Year's Eve. This is the going-out one.
picks.skip_if: You hate strapless, or you might return it. It's final sale.

picks.name: Leopard halter mini
picks.say: If everyone else is in sequins, wear leopard. Halter neck, open back, half price.
picks.why: Lined, tie-up halter, hem is longer at the back. $129 from $259.
picks.for_who: Birthday dinners and parties that aren't formal.
picks.skip_if: You run cold. The back is open. It's also 100% polyester.

picks.name: Silk charmeuse midi
picks.say: This is the grown-up pick. Washable silk, was four twenty-nine, now one thirty-five.
picks.why: Washable silk charmeuse, V-neck, tie at the back, removable shoulder pads. 69% off.
picks.for_who: Work party, then again in spring with a blazer.
picks.skip_if: You want something tight or short. This one hangs loose.

picks.name: Metallic one-sleeve gown
picks.say: A floor-length metallic gown for sixty-four dollars. One sleeve, open back. People will ask where it's from.
picks.why: Stretch lurex, halter neck into one long sleeve. $64 from $159. Also comes in black.
picks.for_who: Winter wedding guest who wants a long dress under $100.
picks.skip_if: The wedding is conservative. The pale one reads almost white.

picks.name: Teal halter midi
picks.say: The color is the reason. Teal, high neck with a rosette, open back, and it's a midi so you can dance.
picks.why: Charmeuse, pleated bodice, about 50 inches long. $198 from $398.
picks.for_who: Winter wedding. It photographs well and it isn't black.
picks.skip_if: You're a 4, or a 12 and up. Those are gone. It's 100% polyester.

picks.name: Fifi ombre sequin midi
picks.say: My splurge. Blue-to-gold sequins, was six ninety-five, now two seventy-eight. Nobody else at the party will have it.
picks.why: Sequins on a mesh base, strapless, side slit. 60% off.
picks.for_who: New Year's Eve, if you want to be the one in the photos.
picks.skip_if: You want to blend in. And check returns first, it's tagged final sale.

picks.name: Velvet one-sleeve gown
picks.chip: Black: XS to XXL in stock
picks.say: My favorite. Black velvet, one sleeve, a long slit, sixty-four dollars. This looks like it cost four hundred.
picks.why: Velvet jersey, column cut, one-shoulder neckline, long side slit. $64 from $159.
picks.for_who: Black tie on a budget. Also the easiest one to rewear.
picks.skip_if: You want the crimson. It's missing XS, S and XL.

script.open: I read almost 400 Black Friday sales. Only 8 stores have party dresses at 50% off, and 87 of the 117 dresses are in two of them. These are my eight favorites.
script.close: That's the whole list. Which one are you wearing on New Year's Eve?
script.tease: Party shoes and bags to go with them.

hooks_alt: 266 dresses are half off this Black Friday. Fewer than half of them are something you could wear to a party.
Your holiday party dress is $64 right now, and it's velvet.
caption: I went through almost 400 Black Friday sales to find party dresses that are really 50% off. Only 8 stores had any, and two of them hold most of the list. Which one would you wear? Commissionable links in bio.
pinned_comment: Prices are from Nov 27 and sizes are going fast. The Mac Duggal and alice + olivia picks are final sale, so check your size before you buy.
recheck: Marcella: live price check was refused. Open the 3 Marcella picks by hand and confirm $71 / $64 / $64 and the sizes.

alice + olivia: the sheet lists 'Black Friday - Extra 30% Off' for Nov 27-28, but the homepage only said 25% off. Check at checkout whether anything stacks on the Fifi dress ($278). If it does, the price in the video is too high.
alice + olivia Fifi dress is tagged FINAL SALE in the catalog. Confirm on the product page before saying it.
Mac Duggal: both picks are final sale, non-returnable (stated in the description).
Marcella has run sales all year (product tags show past 40-60% events), and nearly its whole catalog is marked down now. 'Was' prices are its list prices, not a rare deal.
The party/not-party split was my call from titles and photos. Day dresses, shirt dresses, nightgowns and resort prints are out.
M.M.LaFleur and bübish picks were rechecked live today and matched.
dropped: DISSH, Odd Muse, Soleil Soleil, Antipodean Label, P.E Nation, Beyond Nine: not priced in US dollars
LAKE: nightgowns and cotton day dresses
Marine Layer, Marea, Pistola Denim, Organic Basics, Vitality, 437, Knix: casual or day dresses, nothing for a party
Alexandra Miro: resort prints and cover-ups; only the gold knit Dorian dress counted (final sale)
ANEMOS: 5 counted at 50% off, but photos are flat product shots, so none in candidates
alice + olivia: 30 dresses at 50%+, only 7 are party dresses; the rest are summer prints and eyelet
M.M.LaFleur: 49 dresses at 50%+, 11 counted; the rest are work and day dresses
Marcella: 15 cotton day, shift and rib-knit dresses not counted
Mac Duggal: 6 daytime floral minis not counted (all under 50% anyway)
Social Threads, Heiress Beverly Hills, Petal & Pup, Favorite Daughter: party dresses only at 40-49% off
Marcella Manhattan Slit Gown in red: S and L sold out, so it stayed a candidate only
Mac Duggal black velvet gown 56144: half the sizes gone, kept as candidate
440ME strapless dress, Cozyland (kids): bad photo / not women's
take_sub: 117 party dresses are half off this week. 87 of them sit in two stores.
